title: Implement Renown scoring and Twilight strength combat
description: Approved scoring plan: replace Resonance with Renown. Audience outcomes award Miss=0, Good=2, Perfect=3 Renown, without caps/discards. At Twilight entry Personal Strength equals accumulated Renown; Twilight Strength starts at a positive per-song configurable value, initially100. In Twilight Miss costs3 Personal Strength and deals0 damage; Good costs1 Personal Strength and deals2 damage; Perfect costs0 Personal Strength and deals3 damage. Centralize all outcome values in one shared balance configuration used consistently across game; per-song twilight_strength in song-authoring JSON must flow into generated playable chart. Twilight reaching0 means victory; Personal Strength reaching0 means defeat; excerpt ending while both remain above0 means survived but Twilight undefeated. Terminal combat should stop judging notes and stop playback cleanly; resolve simultaneous depletion deterministically as victory when the hit defeats Twilight (explicit implementation convention). Preserve existing timing windows Perfect inclusive +/-75ms and Good inclusive +/-150ms; discussion deferred to shining-stars-4v0.10. Current36 Twilight notes allow max108 damage and all-good72 versus initial100; accepted for tuning. Keep misses separate from surrender in narrative. Update UI/results/scene resource feedback to show Renown then Personal/Twilight Strength and clear outcome. Test model/config/generator/audio-lifecycle integration and browser outcomes; no installs or remote pushes.
acceptance_criteria: Shared balance values encode specified rewards/costs/damage; deterministic tests cover audience totals, transfer, Good damage+cost, misses, Perfect, zero-strength entry, victory/defeat/survival and terminal immutability. Song twilight_strength validates and round-trips into live chart with100 initial. UI communicates strengths/outcomes without old capped conversion rules. Existing timing windows unchanged. Independent tests/review pass; checkpoint only scoped files.
notes: Independent verification/review accepted, including BC-05. 143 Vitest and 43 Python tests passed; typecheck, lint, format, build/chart checks and real chart regeneration passed. Browser all-miss confirmed Twilight-handoff defeat, early audio stop, and restart. Strategic browser victory remains unverified because a real WebDriver key arrived 154ms late, outside the unchanged timing window; model/controller victory is verified. Follow-up shining-stars-4v0.12 tracks native-input delivery stabilization without fake hits or timing-window changes. User listening/play-test remains open in shining-stars-4v0.7; timing discussion remains open/escalate in shining-stars-4v0.10.
close_reason: Approved Renown/Twilight Strength implementation completed; independent 143-Vitest/43-Python verification, all quality gates, regeneration and all-miss browser defeat/stop/restart accepted. Strategic browser victory limitation is documented in the bead and bounded follow-up shining-stars-4v0.12.

title: Implement per-song aubio authoring and safe chart generation
description: Implement a configurable JSON collection of per-song chart-authoring settings and the aubioonset-based generator. Configure only the existing playable song, identified by stable ID and source path; do not guess excerpt settings for other audio. Its settings are start_time 107.1 seconds, excerpt-relative twilight_time 39.2 seconds, duration 65.8 seconds, minimum_delta 64 milliseconds, stride 2, and lane_rules {type: pattern, data: [0, 2, 1, 3]}. Load and validate the collection, use it as the defaults for generation/checking, and preserve useful CLI overrides and explicit song selection. Extract full-source onset timestamps with installed aubioonset in seconds; greedily retain onsets at least minimum_delta after the last retained onset (equality retained), apply stride to retained onsets, then apply unchanged chart timing guards without resetting at Twilight. Preserve raw onset list, source indices/times, source hash, settings, and tool commands in provenance. Update tests and authoring docs, regenerate the current chart/artifact with installed tools, and verify source/lockfile hashes remain unchanged. No installs/downloads, remote changes, or commits.
acceptance_criteria: Per-song JSON schema/validation, config-driven generation/check, explicit aubioonset detector settings, selection/provenance guards, alternate-source live destination protection, and onset-derived copy are implemented. Independent 43-Python/123-Vitest GREEN, typecheck/lint/format/build/chartcheck/browser checks and BC-03/BC-04 review accepted. Current artifact/chart regenerated; source and lockfile hashes unchanged. Human musical acceptance remains in shining-stars-4v0.7.
notes: Implemented configurable per-song JSON settings for the playable song, aubioonset extraction/provenance, greedy minimum_delta then stride selection, safe live-output policy for alternate sources, and onset-derived UI copy. Regenerated artifact/chart with 1,311 raw onsets and 80 selected notes (44 Audience/36 Twilight). Independent verification passed 43 Python tests, 123 Vitest tests, typecheck, lint, format, build, chart check, and browser checks. BC-03/BC-04 reviewer findings are closed. User listening/play-test remains tracked by shining-stars-4v0.7. No installs or remote changes.
close_reason: Implementation complete; independent 43-Python/123-Vitest GREEN, typecheck/lint/format/build/chart-check and browser verification passed. BC-03/BC-04 reviewer findings closed; live output protection and onset-derived UI copy accepted. Local checkpoint follows; no remote push.
